follow_up_policy: Every original follow-up ID and recorded resolution remains attached to its original contract. A resolution can document partial work without closing the target claim or remaining prerequisites. No unknown status is promoted by this release.

official_fastchem4_comparison.interpretation: Neutral-atom formation K ratios. Updated HCN comes from the full official logK.dat; the stale wo_ions alternatives are excluded. This comparison changes no production source.

issue_mapping_snapshot.scope: Final merged-state publication snapshot used as a routing aid. Repository target inventory and pinned scientific contracts are the offline authorities; this live Issue is not a runtime input.

limitations: All production/source/candidate claims retain their original evidence scope. Records with schema 0.1 retain claim-level statuses rather than invented v0.2 assessment IDs.

Adopted_source describes an implemented correction somewhere in the immutable data chain; retained_source describes an inherited FastChem function. Neither means a source is universally accurate or that every later candidate was adopted.
The original 14 NASA exclusions remain identity/coverage annotations. FastChem record agreement does not resolve them or create missing NASA values.
Complete physical uncertainty and atmospheric predictive accuracy remain unknown. Condensation, transport, photochemistry and retrieval validation are outside this gas-only release.

Direct artifact pins cover the current production and comparison packets. Immutable contract hashes and the scientific snapshot revision identify the original source artifacts and transitive historical hash lists without duplicating them or claiming all ancestral literature is available.
This recording-only release adds no new equilibrium solve, no new source adoption, no software-version change and no Git tag.
